errors.evidence: The description introduces external context that the services are 'provided by some researchers', which is not mentioned in the figure.

The list of services (x-axis categories) is incomplete; it omits the category 'сигнали за забелязани неточности' (signals for noticed inaccuracies).

This sentence, which translates to 'The axes represent authentic inaccuracies', is nonsensical. It seems to be a misinterpretation of the category label 'сигнали за забелязани неточности' (signals for noticed inaccuracies) and incorrectly applies it as a description of the axes.

errors.text_span: достига до 5, т.е. показва стойности от 0 до 5
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the vertical axis scale goes up to 5. The chart clearly shows a bar with a value of 7, and the gridlines extend beyond 5.

errors.text_span: Има йерархично стълбовидно групиране, където всеки стълб представлява определена услуга, натрупана една върху друга, за да покаже общото количество, свързано с тях.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the chart as a stacked bar chart ('натрупана една върху друга' - stacked one on top of the other). The figure is a simple 3D bar chart with individual, non-stacked bars.

errors.text_span: Най-високият стълб представлява “отчети” с височина, еквивалентна на 7
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the tallest bar (value 7) as representing 'отчети' (reports). The tallest bar corresponds to 'статистики' (statistics). The bar for 'отчети' has a value of 2.

errors.text_span: следван от “ста му сику” с височина от 6
errors.evidence: This is incorrect in two ways: the category is 'статистики', not 'ста му сику', and its value is 7, not 6.
The bar for 'alerts услуги' (alerts services) has a value of 1, not 2. The bar with the value 2 corresponds to 'отчети' (reports).
The description fails to mention the title of the chart, 'Други услуги' (Other services), which states its main purpose.
